description: This Java class represents artifact information for Service ECA (Event-Condition-Action) rules within the Apache OFBiz framework. It maintains references to a ServiceEcaRule, tracks services called or triggering this rule, provides display metadata, and can generate data models for external use.

classes.name: ServiceEcaArtifactInfo
classes.description: Represents artifact metadata for a Service ECA rule, including references to the rule, trigger/call services, and methods to generate visual/model representations.

methods.name: populateAll
methods.description: Populates the set of services called by this Service ECA based on its actions, and updates referencing maps.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name, prefixed if applicable.

methods.name: getDisplayType
methods.description: Returns a string indicating the type of artifact, 'Service ECA'.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type identifier for Service ECA info.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Provides a unique identifier based on the rule's string representation.

methods.name: getLocationURL
methods.description: Resolves the location URL of the Service ECA rule's definition.

methods.name: setDisplayPrefix
methods.description: Sets a prefix for the display name.

methods.name: setDisplaySuffixNum
methods.description: Sets a suffix number for display purposes.

methods.name: getDisplayPrefixedName
methods.description: Returns a display name that includes prefix, service name, event name, and suffix.

methods.name: getServicesCalledByServiceEcaActions
methods.description: Returns the set of services called by this Service ECA.

methods.name: getServicesTriggeringServiceEca
methods.description: Returns services that trigger this Service ECA.

methods.name: createEoModelMap
methods.description: Creates a map suitable for external modeling, representing the Service ECA's conditions, actions, and relationships.
